issue_title: [Feature] Add CLI 'rename' command to expose Todo.rename() functionality

implementation.changes_summary: Added CLI 'rename' subcommand that exposes Todo.rename() functionality. Changes include: (1) TodoApp.rename() method to call Todo.rename() and persist, (2) 'rename' subcommand in build_parser() with id and text arguments, (3) 'rename' case in run_command() to handle the command.

acceptance_criteria.valid_rename: PASS - 'todo rename 1 new text' successfully renames todo #1
acceptance_criteria.invalid_id: PASS - 'todo rename 99 x' returns error for non-existent id
acceptance_criteria.empty_text: PASS - 'todo rename 1 ""' returns error for empty text
